propositions: Close must validate that the current plan and pinned upstream plans have not materially changed during ticket execution, without blocking code-drift changes or requiring revalidation of implementation files
The plan-review close gate runs only when require_plan_review_for_close=true, executes before completion verification inside a single transaction lock, and never invokes models or network calls
Unsigned reviews, reopened tickets, stale registry entries, own-material drift, malformed metadata, and phase incompatibility must block close; pin enforcement controls only pin-health validation
A pre_status_check generic transaction callback executes inside the write lock after structural checks and before STATUS append, catching state changes between precheck and lock
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea-to-closed) and force-close bypass scope remain unchanged
Failure messages use exact verdict prefixes and direct users to run review-plan separately, with unexpected exceptions failing closed as unavailable without traceback
